_note: Everything past the basics is opened through adventures. Each unlock has 'earn': every condition must be met ('find': a special item a pet brought home from a trip, see 'finds' and the events that give them; 'first': the first of something, 'part' or 'toy'; 'trips': adventures welcomed back; 'machine': a node on the machine's tree is fixed; 'packs_opened': packs you opened yourself; 'open': another unlock id that must be open already, e.g. 'feature:parts'; 'taught': a job your pet has been taught in the automation tab (data/automation.json); 'others': a job the other pets have been taught (the automation tab's workers); 'job_level': { job id: level } an errand's level, see data/errands.json; 'called': true, only the game's code opens it, see GameState.open_page (next door opens when the first page past the edge is full); 'all_places': a map page id, every place on it is open; 'edge': a page id past the edge that's full, see data/edge.json; 'edge_sent': pets sent past the edge, ever; 'floor': the deepest floor the dungeon's army has cleared, see data/dungeon.json; 'sewing': rooms of the sewing room cleared, see data/sewing.json). 'learns': your pet knows this automation job as soon as it opens (no teaching). 'show' is how it looks until then: 'locked' (a tab with a padlock and the 'hint') or 'hidden' (not there at all). 'opens' is what it turns on: 'tab:<name>', 'feature:<id>' (plushie = the workbench's plushie machine page, edge = the signpost past the beyond page, school = the automation tab's school page, errands, packs = the automation tab's open boxes job, auto_adventures = its run adventures job, shopping = your pet buys more boxes when the pile runs out, parties, whistle = your pet manages the workers, dungeon = the adventures tab's dungeon page, lead_army = the automation job that leads the army) 'page:<id>' (a map page) or 'job:<id>' (an errand, see its 'needs'); new_homes = the new homes stall on the pets tab, sorting = its sorting rule card, sewing = the sewing room's door on the well's floor 20, keep_lines = the sorting card's keep lines, wish = the wishing jar by the collection book. More earn conditions: 'room': 'full' (the room has been full once), 'homes_by_hand': pets sent to new homes from the stall. 'quiet': true opens it without the popup card (your pet just says the 'announce' line). 'pet_job': a pet comes with it and starts on that errand. 'button_gift': that many buttons are sewn onto your active pet (on its best knack's part, see Plushie). A find's 'given_by' names what gives it when that's not an adventure event, a dungeon floor or the capsule machine. 'announce' is what your active pet says when it opens. 'popup' is the card that pops up then: its 'title', a line of 'text' on what it does, and 'go', the tab its show me button opens (none: just lovely). PAGES are the map's pages, in order: 'paper': 'night' draws it on night paper, 'layout': 'street' draws next door's row of gardens (StreetPage), 'ours_after' is how many visits until a place on it becomes ours (only once next door is open, see data/adventures.json 'ours').

popup.title: new: boxes!
popup.text: boxes have pets inside! buy them with coins and rip them open. your pile of boxes lives here too.

unlocks.announce: boxes came out of the machine! there are pets inside them!

unlocks.hint: something's rusted shut in the capsule machine

popup.title: new: capsule toys!
popup.text: the capsule machine has toys in it now! give one to your pet to play with and it helps you out while it plays.

unlocks.announce: something new is rattling in the capsule machine!

unlocks.hint: pets bring things home from their adventures, and toys come out of the capsule machine

popup.title: new: the workbench!
popup.text: parts your pets bring home go on the workbench. try them on your pets and sew them on there!

unlocks.announce: a pet brought something home! it's on the workbench now!

unlocks.hint: toys come out of the capsule machine

popup.title: new: the workbench!
popup.text: toys go in the collectibles tab. on the workbench you can make them better: combine spares, fix them up, or risk a few for a shiny one!

unlocks.announce: a toy! i put it with my collectibles ♡

popup.title: new: errands!
popup.text: a pet was asleep in the basket! it's on the coin hunt now: pets on errands find coins while you're busy. give them better tools with your coins on the upgrades page!

unlocks.announce: a little basket, with a pet asleep in it! it wants a job, so it's sniffing for coins!

popup.title: new: a lemonade stand!
popup.text: the coin hunt found an old lemonade stand by the gate! pets sell lemonade there, and rarer pets get bigger tips.

unlocks.announce: we found a lemonade stand by the gate! can we open it? please?

popup.title: new: a savings jar!
popup.text: the lemonade stand saved up enough for a big glass jar! pets drop coins in and wait. it fills slowly, then pays out all at once.

unlocks.announce: a big jar! if we put every coin in it, it gets FULL. then we tip it out!

popup.title: new: a kitchen!
popup.text: the coin hunt sniffed out a little kitchen! pets who cook keep everyone on errands going a bit faster, and there's a meal for me now and then.

unlocks.announce: a kitchen!! i can smell it from here. i'll be the taster.

popup.title: new: scouting!
popup.text: the savings jar paid for a little lookout by the fence! scouts write notes about what's out there, and the next trips take them along.

unlocks.announce: a lookout! we can peek over the fence and write down everything we see.

popup.title: new: small parties!
popup.text: the little cart fits three friends: send them on adventures together! more friends bring home more, and tricky bits get easier. but more friends can get hurt too.

unlocks.announce: a cart! three friends can go on adventures together now!

popup.title: new: beyond the fence!
popup.text: a scrap of a map came out of the capsule machine! someone drew what's past the fence. there's a whole new page on the map!

unlocks.announce: a map of past the fence! there's so much out there. let's go see all of it!

popup.title: new: next door!
popup.text: past the edge of the fence there's a whole row of gardens, and all their lights are on. there's a new page on the map!

unlocks.announce: there are gardens next door! let's tiptoe over and have a look.

popup.title: new: parts!
popup.text: pets can bring body parts home from adventures now. on the workbench you can sew them onto your pet. every part rolls its own little bonus!

unlocks.announce: i found an ear on the path! a spare one. can i wear it?

popup.title: new: bigger parties!
popup.text: the wheelbarrow fits five friends. more friends bring home more, and tricky bits get easier!

unlocks.announce: a wheelbarrow! five friends can go together now!

popup.title: new: big parties!
popup.text: the hay wagon fits ten friends! a whole party on one adventure.

unlocks.announce: a hay wagon!! ten friends fit in it! i counted twice.

popup.title: new: automation!
popup.text: your pet fixed the tiny capsule machine all by itself! teach it a job with coins and it does it for you while you're busy.

unlocks.announce: i watched you fix every single gear. i fixed the tiny machine all by myself! can i crank it?

popup.title: new: run adventures!
popup.text: your pet can learn to run adventures: it sends a party out and sends it again when it's home.

unlocks.announce: i could send the others out for you! i know all the places by now.

popup.title: new: open boxes!
popup.text: on its comfy cushion, your pet can open the boxes on your pile for you. teach it in the automation tab; pick which boxes it may open in the boxes tab.

unlocks.announce: a comfy cushion! i could sit here and open boxes for you!

popup.title: new: your pet buys boxes!
popup.text: with the piggy bank, your pet buys more boxes when the pile runs out. it always keeps the coins you set aside.

unlocks.announce: a piggy bank! now i can buy boxes when the pile runs out! i'll always keep some coins for you ♪

popup.title: new: the whistle!
popup.text: with the whistle, your pet manages the workers: it hauls old machines and tables home from places you've taken, and keeps them full. it always keeps the coins you set aside.

unlocks.announce: tweet! everyone, line up!
a little stall popped up by the shelves ♪
i made a little card for the stall!

popup.title: new: the edge!
popup.text: past the orchard the map just stops. pets who go past the edge don't come back. they draw the rest of the map for us!

unlocks.announce: the map stops! right past the orchard. somebody has to go and draw the rest.

popup.title: new: the little school!
popup.text: spare pets can go to school and stay on as teachers. every class that finishes makes every worker a bit quicker, for good.

unlocks.announce: i made a little school! the others can learn to be teachers.

popup.title: new: the old well, all the way down!
popup.text: the rope goes further down than anyone's been. line up a front row and some of the herd, and send them down floor by floor!

unlocks.announce: the rope goes waaay down. i packed snacks!

popup.title: new: lead the army!
popup.text: your pet knows the way down now. put it on the job in automation and it takes the same army down again whenever everyone's home.

unlocks.announce: i know the way down now! i could take everyone myself!

popup.title: new: the plushie machine!
popup.text: a real working plushie machine, on the workbench! pick a pet to make extra special, then pull the lever. and look, a button!

unlocks.announce: a plushie machine! it sewed a button on me! do i look fancy?
there's a tiny pink door on floor 20. the key fits it!

popup.title: new: keep lines!
popup.text: the sorting card can keep pets now. pick a kind, and the newest ones from your boxes stay cards, ready for the front row.

unlocks.announce: there was a little card in the button tin! i put it with the sorting card.

popup.title: new: a wishing jar!
popup.text: a big glass jar turned up next to the sticker book. wish for a sticker, and pets who hop in help it come true. they don't come back out.

unlocks.announce: there's a jar by the sticker book! i think it's for wishes.
